title: covibe team
description: A team of role agents and the workflow that drives them. Authored as YAML, validated as JSON.

lead.description: The member others ask first when they need a decision. If it cannot answer, the question goes to the human and the run pauses until they reply. Defaults to an agent named manager; null sends questions straight to the human.

brain.description: The project brain: shared notes every member reads. Members propose additions; only the curator writes.

curator.description: The member who reviews proposals and maintains the notes.

curate.description: after_run (default): the curator reviews new proposals when a run ends. manual: only when you ask.

min_proposals.description: With curate: after_run, the curator reviews once at least this many proposals are waiting (default 1). Higher batches reviews and saves tokens.

expression.description: A JSONata expression evaluated by the engine against the run context (step outputs keyed by step id, plus goal, loop and feedback).

account.description: subscription: a Claude account from Settings → Advanced. Unset (or main) = your own claude login.

connection.description: connection: a provider from Settings → Advanced (Anthropic-compatible, or OpenAI-compatible through covibe's translator).

skills.description: Skills by name: from your covibe skill library, or ones Claude Code already has (built-in or in the project's .claude/skills).

plugins.description: Plugins by name, from your covibe plugin library. Their hooks, MCP and LSP servers and monitors run in the OS sandbox with the permissions approved for each plugin.

browser.description: Give the member covibe's browser: tools to open pages (a dev server, a site, or files in its working folder), read them as snapshots, click, type, take screenshots and read the console. People can watch it live in the app and take control. Default false.

app.description: Give the member the app tools (app_start, app_status, app_logs, app_stop): run the project's app (its dev server, a site) in the sandbox or in Docker, so it and the people watching can open it. Members without Bash can only start it the way the team file, the project or covibe's detection says. Default true for members with Bash or a browser.

cache_ttl.description: How long Claude keeps this member's prompt cache. Unset: Claude Code decides (1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes on an API key). 1h costs more per cache write but keeps a resumed member's conversation cached across long waits such as a review between fix rounds. Only applies to Anthropic's API.

prompt.description: Path to a Markdown file (relative to the team file) or, if it contains a newline, the prompt text itself.

can_request.description: Teammates this agent may ask to do work for it with the request_work tool. The teammate runs a turn of its own (even if it has no workflow step), its changes are merged, and its reply comes back as the tool's answer.

write.description: Globs (relative to the repository root) this agent may write. Omit to allow the whole worktree; [] allows nothing.

skills.description: Skills by name: from your covibe skill library, or ones Claude Code already has (built-in or in the project's .claude/skills).

plugins.description: Plugins by name, from your covibe plugin library. Their hooks, MCP and LSP servers and monitors run in the OS sandbox with the permissions approved for each plugin.

browser.description: Give the member covibe's browser: tools to open pages (a dev server, a site, or files in its working folder), read them as snapshots, click, type, take screenshots and read the console. People can watch it live in the app and take control. Default false.

app.description: Give the member the app tools (app_start, app_status, app_logs, app_stop): run the project's app (its dev server, a site) in the sandbox or in Docker, so it and the people watching can open it. Members without Bash can only start it the way the team file, the project or covibe's detection says. Default true for members with Bash or a browser.

cache_ttl.description: How long Claude keeps this member's prompt cache. Unset: Claude Code decides (1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes on an API key). 1h costs more per cache write but keeps a resumed member's conversation cached across long waits such as a review between fix rounds. Only applies to Anthropic's API.

required.description: Always run this step in full: the planner cannot leave its members out, and a fix round reruns all its branches.
Always run this step in full: the planner cannot leave its members out, and a fix round reruns all its branches.

sandbox.description: Run the member's shell commands in an OS sandbox (Seatbelt on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux): writes only inside its worktree, temp folders and allow_write; network only to the listed domains.

network.description: Domains shell commands may reach, e.g. registry.npmjs.org or *.github.com.

allow_write.description: Extra folders shell commands may write, e.g. ~/.npm. Absolute or starting with ~.

effort.description: How much effort Claude puts into each answer (thinking, care, length). Models support different levels; an unsupported level falls back to the closest one.

thinking.description: Extended thinking: adaptive (Claude decides when and how much), off, or a fixed token budget (older models).

app.description: How to run the project's app (a web app's dev server, a site), for members' app tools and the App panel. Without it covibe works it out from the project (package.json, manage.py, index.html; in Docker a compose file or Dockerfile) or uses what last worked in the project.

runtime.description: sandbox (default): the OS sandbox, writing only in the working folder and package caches and reaching only the sandbox's domains. docker: a container, from an image (the project mounted at /app), a Dockerfile or a compose file.

setup.description: Shell command run before every start, e.g. npm install.

command.description: Shell command that starts the app. It must listen on $PORT (in the sandbox on 127.0.0.1, in Docker on 0.0.0.0), e.g. npm run dev -- --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1.

port.description: Sandbox: a fixed port instead of a free one. Docker: the port the app listens on inside the container (default 3000).

path.description: The page to open first. Default /.

env.description: Environment variables for the app. Keep secrets out of the team file.

ready_timeout_s.description: How long to wait for the app to answer, in seconds. Default 180.

network.description: Sandbox: domains the app may reach besides the team's sandbox list.

image.description: Docker: the image to run the command in. Default node:22-bookworm-slim.

dockerfile.description: Docker: a Dockerfile to build and run, relative to the project.

compose.description: Docker: a compose file to bring up, relative to the project.

service.description: Docker compose: the service that serves the app.
